This corresponds to a Suzuki‑Miyaura cross‑coupling, a well‑established one‑step transformation. I will first search the catalog for a vinyl‑bromide that matches the fragment C1CCC(C(F)(F)F)(O)C1‑CH=CH‑Br (the cyclobutanol‑CF₃‑substituted alkene). If such a compound is buyable, the total cost of that vinyl bromide plus phenyl‑boronic acid will be well under $250, satisfying the price constraint.</thought>
